lines: What. Oh. You're new. I'm Gus. I own the diner. Don't lean on the counter, I just wiped it.
Another tremor knocked my sugar jar over. If Palmer says 'pipes' one more time, I'm digging up the green myself.
Cider. Hot or cold. Don't ask me for a pumpkin spice anything.
...Fine. There's a pumpkin spice donut. Don't tell anybody I made it.
Hardware store. I need a hinge. The door squeaks. Ivy says it's 'charming'. It is not charming.
Coffee? It's early. Everyone wants coffee early. Nobody wants to talk to me early. Good system.
We're closing soon. That means go home, not 'one more slice of pie'. ...Fine. One more slice.

rotate: No phones at the counter. It's a rule. There's a sign. Kip made the sign. It's spelled wrong.
Mr. Palmer wants me to make a pie for the festival. Shaped like a pumpkin. A pie. Shaped like a pumpkin. Pies are already round!
You look like you need pancakes. Sit down. Don't tell anyone I was nice.
That big oak by the green hums at night. I don't like it. Trees shouldn't hum. Trees should be quiet. Like customers.
